meta.name: BASE44_BUILD_PLAN
meta.purpose: Machine-readable execution state + remaining runway for the whole build. BASE44_APP_SPEC.json is the static design index (entities/screens/jobs); THIS file is the live plan: what is done (with evidence grade), what runs next, in what order, behind which gates. The Base44 agent reads this WITH PROTOCOL.md; PROGRESS.md remains the append-only ledger and wins on any conflict about what actually happened.
meta.how_to_use: Owner says 'continue the plan'. Agent: (1) read this file + PROTOCOL.md; (2) take the lowest-order work_queue item whose actor is 'base44' and whose blocking list is clear; (3) run it exactly per PROTOCOL steps 2-7 (load the slice file + its named specialists, 3-line confirm, build, gate-stop, acceptance PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED, ledger append); (4) never start an item whose blocking entry is open; (5) items with actor 'owner' or 'codex' are NOT yours - skip them silently.
meta.honesty_contract: Tags [FACT]/[FACT-source]/[ESTIMATE]/[METHOD]/[UNKNOWN]/[SIGNAL] are load-bearing. evidence_grade in slice_status distinguishes owner-reported (stated in chat, not independently re-checked) from audit-verified (independent Codex/repo audit). Never upgrade a grade without the audit.
meta.credit_discipline: PROTOCOL.md credit section binds: one item = one build pass; batch fixes; stop after 2 failed attempts; prefer owner API keys over built-in services; state Automation runs/month at schedule_enable.
